content.text: Digital creators in regions with [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-19|payment]] processing barriers often struggle to sell their products online. Platforms like PayPal and Stripe are either blocked or too costly, particularly in terms of fees that eat into profits. For example, Gumroad takes a 10% cut on sales, while alternative solutions like NOWPayments only charge 0.5%. This breakdown will explain how to leverage Cloudflare R2 for storing and delivering digital products efficiently, without reliance on conventional payment processors.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-every-detail-you-5. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 is a powerful object storage solution designed to provide a seamless, low-cost way to host and serve digital products. In areas where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, it offers creators a way to maintain full control over their assets and transactions. R2 allows creators to upload [[LINK:https://coremerch.[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-explained-14|COREMERCH guide to github]].io/store/blog/how-how-sell-ebooks-kenya-complete-infrastructure-guide-18|How to]], courses, templates, and other digital goods while ensuring fast, reliable delivery to customers. This infrastructure is crucial for creators who want to eliminate dependency on traditional platforms that impose high fees or geographical restrictions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the architecture surrounding Cloudflare R2 relies on a combination of free and reliable technologies. R2 acts as the storage layer, where your digital products reside. When a customer makes a purchase, a lightweight backend, powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, processes the order. NOWPayments integrates effortlessly into this setup, enabling cryptocurrency payments with minimal fees. This architecture ensures that once your system is set up, you can manage transactions and deliveries autonomously, allowing for instant access to products without manual intervention.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators in regions where payment processors are limited or unreliable. If you are selling eBooks, online courses, or digital templates, and find yourself losing a significant portion of your earnings to platform fees, this system provides a sustainable alternative. By utilizing Cloudflare R2 alongside NOWPayments, you can create a seamless buying experience for customers while retaining a greater share of your revenue. This setup is particularly valuable for creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Zimbabwe, where traditional payment methods may not be an option.
Cloudflare R2 offers reliable and scalable storage for your digital products.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The successful deployment of a digital product store using Cloudflare R2 involves several key components. R2 serves as the file repository, where you store your digital products for secure and efficient delivery. The backend logic, created through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, manages orders and triggers file delivery upon successful payment. NOWPayments facilitates the cryptocurrency transactions with an incredibly low fee, ensuring that your profits remain intact. Each component communicates effectively, creating a streamlined process for both you and your customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with your own digital store using Cloudflare R2, first, sign up for a Cloudflare account and set up R2 for storage. Next, choose your backend logic platform, either Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and set up the necessary scripts for order processing. Integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you can accept a variety of coins with low fees. Finally, upload your digital products to R2 and test the entire workflow before going live. For a detailed guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% on transactions, significantly less than traditional platforms.

If you're looking for ways to sell digital downloads without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip, consider investing in the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit provides all the necessary blueprints and templates to build your sovereign digital commerce stack.
Your Deployment Checklist

Sign up for a Cloudflare account and set up R2 for your digital product storage. Choose either Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend processing. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions to handle payments efficiently. Upload your digital products to R2 and ensure they are accessible. Test the entire workflow before launching your store to ensure a smooth customer experience.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook by using Cloudflare R2 for storage and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions. This setup allows you to bypass traditional payment platforms while maintaining control and low fees.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?
Using Cloudflare R2 along with NOWPayments is an effective way to sell digital downloads without incurring high platform fees. This combination ensures you keep more of your revenue from each sale.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, by leveraging Cloudflare R2 for storage and using NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, you can sell templates and fonts independently, avoiding the fees charged by platforms like Gumroad or Payhip.
What are the advantages of using Cloudflare R2 for digital products?
Cloudflare R2 provides secure, fast storage for your digital products with no vendor lock-in. It enables easy and automated delivery to customers while maintaining low operational costs.
How do I set up payments for my digital products?
To set up payments, integrate NOWPayments into your existing system. This allows you to accept multiple cryptocurrencies with low transaction fees, ensuring a cost-effective payment solution.
By owning your infrastructure, you eliminate reliance on any third-party payment processor.
